g.text: Original CORE | Every common-finite single-module contrast
Δ = Proposed − the corresponding one-module-off configuration. Negative favors Proposed; positive favors the ablation.
All saved paired points shown; diamonds: saved paired median. Symmetric-log axes resolve small effects without deleting large ones.
